intent: Aries and Capricorn use whole-building silhouettes. Owner restored Taurus to the original shared zodiac sprite.

prompts.aries: Use case: stylized-concept. A production game-map building sprite, isolated on genuine transparent background, entire single building visible. High quality finely textured pixel-game architecture matching the two supplied APPROVED Leo and Cancer references: reference images set only the rendering technique, orthographic camera seen from the south at slight top-down angle, warm small windows, native game scale and open meeting-room entrance. Build a COMPLETELY NEW silhouette, architectural massing and structural walls specific to the subject. A whole unique building, NOT an ordinary symmetrical house with a zodiac head/emblem stamped onto the facade. NO crests, shield plaques, animal heads, medallions, pasted zodiac emblems, signs, letters, giant ornaments on a generic roof. NO Renaissance palazzo. Proportions nearly square whole footprint, full building fits a 12 by 12 tile canvas. One small open entrance centered exactly on the SOUTH bottom edge; doorway roughly one sixth of building width, its threshold at bottom, flat accessible threshold with no outdoor stair, warmly lit auditorium visible. Grounded base fills width except centered doorway. Keep roof projections in upper two thirds, actual walls at lower third so perspective matches game collision footprint. Strong coherent material construction, crisp silhouette, no scenery background, no detached props or frame. ARIES: an original ram-inspired curved-rampart citadel. The building itself is two enormous tightly curling spiral galleries wrapping inward like ram horns, these are inhabited architectural wings with inset narrow windows and masonry joints, not detached horns or sculptures. Burnished dark copper ribs sweep continuously around each curl; weathered deep red sandstone walls. A low faceted wedge-shaped central entrance joins the two curls and a narrow lantern ridge rises at the back. Architectural spiral negative spaces near the top make the silhouette immediately legible even in black. Rounded muscular side massing, sweeping roof ribs, completely unlike Leo's straight stepped tower and Cancer's flat dome. No ram head or badge anywhere; the paired curled inhabited wings ARE Aries.
